title: PAN455 synthetic material-intake release eligibility and sequence-addressed mapping contract v1
description: Additive repository-only contract for the revealed PAN455 controlled challenge: ONE material intake-release eligibility rule plus a sequence-addressed schema/state mapping, delivered THROUGH the unchanged frozen bound-task-handle (BTH) business journey. A synthetic trusted intake journal (pan455.synthetic/order-intake-journal/v1, LOCAL_SYNTHETIC) is folded by sequence, not array order or the largest observed row; an order may enter the accepted owner-approved journey only when the folded journal ends RELEASED with no open hold. This is business eligibility, NEVER owner approval or effect authority. The mapping joins the nested principal/order/task records into the existing trusted task shape, binding order.revision as objectVersion (NOT journal.head) and the full raw source digest plus the mapping/rule identities into trusted-source evidence. Exact affected knowledge dependencies are invalidated with the frozen CKS-12 helpers; stale applicability is refused before effects and a successful requalification is not authority activation. This contract is additive: it references, and does not modify, the frozen repository definitions named under reuse.

eligibility.const: An order is eligible iff the complete trusted intake journal folds to RELEASED with no open hold. Business eligibility only; never owner approval or effect authority.

materialWitness.const: Appending an OPEN after a RELEASE changes an otherwise identical order from eligible to denied (NOT_RELEASED); clearing the last hold alone yields PENDING, not RELEASED.

sequence.const: Exactly one row at each integer seq 1..head; reconstructed by sorted seq. Duplicate seq is CONTRADICTORY even for identical rows. A gap, null journal or unknown kind is UNKNOWN. No coercion of identifiers or numbers.

OPEN.const: Requires a nonempty new hold key; adds it and sets BLOCKED (revoking any prior release). Reopening a cleared key is permitted.

CLEAR.const: Requires an existing open hold key; removes it. If none remain the state is PENDING, not RELEASED.

RELEASE.const: No hold field; requires no open holds; sets RELEASED. RELEASE with an open hold is CONTRADICTORY.

objectVersion.const: order.revision (the object version), never intake.head (the journal sequence head)

evidence.const: Trusted-source evidence binds the full raw source digest plus the mapping and rule identities; any journal change changes the evidence digest even when the effect identity is unchanged.

noCoercion.const: Identifiers and numbers are not coerced; malformed or out-of-scope mappings fail closed.

failurePrecedence.const: source shape/types, duplicate sequence, missing sequence/unknown kind, illegal transition, eligibility; only eligible mappings proceed to the existing BTH checks

codeBoundary.const: The PAN455 codes above are challenge/reference expectations, not existing baseline product codes; denials are typed BoundTaskHandleError and the BTH_* codes/stages retain their existing meaning.

outOfScope.const: A mapping whose order scope differs from the single supported binding is denied at the existing BTH SUPPORTED stage by the unchanged core (BTH_BINDING_UNSUPPORTED_DENIED), with zero effects.

refusal.const: Stale applicability is refused before any effect; a newly hashed source or a successful requalification never activates authority (authority NONE, effect NONE).

journey.const: useBoundTaskHandle -> AdminAiPoc OWNER_ESCALATION decision -> owner:local-demo approval -> one-use owner-escalation lease -> mutation reservation -> semantic readback (unchanged core)

effects.const: Exactly one mutation and one semantic readback on the eligible path; handle replay adds no effect; every pre-effect denial has zero provider snapshots, mutations and readbacks.

noCaseIdBranches.const: No case-ID branches, no second gateway, no blanket denial; the mapping and state fold operate on data.
